items.question: Where do you work?
items.answer: Alterbloom is based in London and works across London and the wider South East. Planning something further afield? Message us. [Travel policy.]

items.question: Do you work with queer couples and non-traditional weddings?
items.answer: Yes, that's who we started this for. Elopements, courthouse parties, mixed-culture weddings, no-tradition weddings. Your way, your day.

items.question: Can you help if we want to DIY some of it?
items.answer: Yes. We made our own wedding flowers by hand. We can give you ideas and a hand, not a full-service takeover.

items.question: Do you plan the entertainment too?
items.answer: Yes. Hosts, drag performers, bhangra and Bollywood dancers, first dances with a plot twist. Decor and entertainment, planned as one show.
